capabilities.name: Governed Product Entity Resolution
capabilities.responsibility: Admit already-reviewed product identity references into an immutable runtime registry, resolve product references by deterministic governed precedence, preserve ambiguity and non-resolution, and publish a bounded planner execution scope only for a unique resolved entity.
capabilities.authority_role: Runtime product-identity resolution and planner-scope authority only; it does not verify source documents, extract or infer UINs, retrieve product evidence, resolve terminology beyond normalized exact governed matching, assess suitability, compare, rank, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Runtime identity admission requires a human-reviewed product_identity_reference_v1 with exact UIN evidence and explicit manual-review evidence.
Resolution uses deterministic governed precedence only and must preserve AMBIGUOUS, NOT_RESOLVED, and INVALID_INPUT outcomes instead of guessing.
Only a uniquely RESOLVED governed entity may produce a READY planner handoff; blocked or invalid outcomes cannot publish product execution scope.
Planner handoff carries identity scope only and does not grant evidence, reasoning, comparison, ranking, suitability, or recommendation authority.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing governed product-entity runtime. Factory-side product identity verification remains authoritative upstream; this capability consumes only identity references that satisfy its explicit admission contract.
